from flint import acb, arb, ctx
from math import comb, factorial
ctx.prec = 200
N=14
# F(s) = (s-1) zeta(s) = 1 + sum_{n>=0} (-1)^n gamma_n/n! (s-1)^{n+1}, coefficients in t = s-1
F=[acb(1)]+[acb(-1)**n*acb.stieltjes(n)/factorial(n) for n in range(N)]
dF=[F[i+1]*(i+1) for i in range(N)]
# Q = dF / F as series
Q=[]
for k in range(N-1):
    s=dF[k]-sum((F[k-i]*Q[i] for i in range(k)), acb(0))
    Q.append(s/F[0])
lp=acb.pi().log()
G=[(-lp/2 if k==0 else acb(0)) + acb(0.5).polygamma(k)/(2*factorial(k)*acb(2)**k) for k in range(N-1)]
A=[acb(-1)**k+Q[k]+G[k] for k in range(N-1)]
for n in range(3):
    lam=sum((comb(n+1,k+1)*A[k] for k in range(n+1)), acb(0))
    print(n+1, lam.real.str(30))
"
